name: add
description:
Copy a file into a folder of word lists under a name.

An existing list is refused without --replace.
A folder that is not searched for lists gets a warning: @NAME finds the list only once the folder is in SEMKIT_LISTS or the config key lists.
With --dry-run the file is not copied.

Example: semkit lists add niche/mebel mebel.txt --to project

options.name: --to
options.description: Where to put the list: 'project' (the project's .rb_semkit/lists) or the path of a folder of lists; ~ is the home folder.

options.name: --replace
options.description: Overwrite the list when the folder has it.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what would happen without making changes.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: The name to give the list, as niche/mebel.

arguments.name: file
arguments.description: The text file to copy: one item per line, a first line '# …' is the description.
